scenario.name: startup
scenario.title: Series A SaaS startup
scenario.summary: Eleven identities, four years of growth, no IAM review. Every grant below was reasonable on the day somebody made it.

nodes.label: Platform group
nodes.note: Read access for the platform team.

nodes.label: App runtime
nodes.note: Execution role for the customer-facing worker.

nodes.label: Data engineering
nodes.note: Nightly batch jobs. Runs with an ExternalId taken from the pipeline config.

nodes.label: Deploy role
nodes.note: GitHub Actions assumes this on every merge to main.

nodes.label: Bastion role
nodes.note: Instance profile for the jump host.

nodes.label: Platform admin
nodes.note: The role that can do anything. Assumed by the platform team through SSO.

nodes.label: Billing analyst
nodes.note: Reads invoices. Has no route to anything.

nodes.label: CI deploy key
nodes.note: Long-lived access key committed to a private repo in 2021.

nodes.label: Platform on-call
nodes.note: Shared on-call identity. Rotated by whoever is on shift.

nodes.label: Security admin
nodes.note: Break-glass administrator. No access key, hardware key only.

nodes.label: Support contractor
nodes.note: External contractor. Key issued for a two-week migration in 2023 and never closed.

registry.name: Cross-role assumption
registry.summary: The trust policy admits this principal and its policy allows sts:AssumeRole.
registry.fix: Scope the trust policy to a role ARN or aws:PrincipalArn condition, not the account root.

registry.name: PassRole into Lambda
registry.summary: Pass a privileged role to a new function, then invoke it.
registry.fix: Restrict iam:PassRole with iam:PassedToService and an explicit role allowlist.

registry.name: PassRole into EC2
registry.summary: Launch an instance with an instance profile and read its metadata credentials.
registry.fix: Deny iam:PassRole for EC2 unless the caller owns the instance profile.

registry.name: PassRole into CloudFormation
registry.summary: Create a stack with a service role and let the template call IAM.
registry.fix: Deny cloudformation:CreateStack with a RoleARN outside the team boundary.

registry.name: PassRole into Glue
registry.summary: Create a development endpoint that runs with the passed role.
registry.fix: Block glue:CreateDevEndpoint, or pin iam:PassRole to a known role.

registry.name: PassRole into SageMaker
registry.summary: Create a notebook instance with the passed role, then open its terminal.
registry.fix: Deny sagemaker:CreateNotebookInstance with an arbitrary execution role.

registry.name: Rewrite a function's code
registry.summary: Replace the handler of an existing function that already holds a strong role.
registry.fix: Separate UpdateFunctionCode permission from InvokeFunction on production functions.

registry.name: Shell through SSM
registry.summary: Run a command on an instance and use its instance profile.
registry.fix: Scope ssm:SendCommand to document ARNs and tag-gated instances.

registry.name: Attach a policy to yourself
registry.summary: Attach AdministratorAccess to your own user and inherit it.
registry.fix: No human or machine identity should hold iam:AttachUserPolicy on its own ARN.

registry.name: Write an inline policy on yourself
registry.summary: Add an inline administrator statement to your own user.
registry.fix: Treat iam:PutUserPolicy on self as equivalent to administrator.

registry.name: New version of an attached policy
registry.summary: Publish a new policy version that grants more than the current one.
registry.fix: CreatePolicyVersion on a policy you can also attach is a standing admin grant.

registry.name: Activate a dormant policy version
registry.summary: Promote an older, wider policy version that is still stored.
registry.fix: Delete unused policy versions and block SetDefaultPolicyVersion.

registry.name: Attach a policy to a trusted role
registry.summary: Attach an administrator policy to a role you can already assume.
registry.fix: Only a break-glass pipeline should hold iam:AttachRolePolicy.

registry.name: Inline policy on a trusted role
registry.summary: Write an inline administrator statement onto a role you can assume.
registry.fix: Block iam:PutRolePolicy outside the IAM administration role.

registry.name: Rewrite a trust policy
registry.summary: Add yourself to a role's trust policy, then assume it.
registry.fix: iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy belongs only to the identity plane, never to workloads.

registry.name: Mint credentials for another user
registry.summary: Create an access key for a user with more access than you.
registry.fix: Deny iam:CreateAccessKey on all principals except a tightly held recovery role.

registry.name: Set a console password for another user
registry.summary: Create a console login for a stronger identity without touching its keys.
registry.fix: Alert on CreateLoginProfile and UpdateLoginProfile outside the IdP flow.

registry.name: Join a more privileged group
registry.summary: Add yourself to a group that carries wider policies.
registry.fix: Group membership changes are privilege changes; route them through review.
